metadataRaw.title: 30 SECOND FIX: Instant Upper Back Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a collection of proven exercises that target two of the main muscles responsible for upper back pain—the upper trapezius and levator scapulae.

These exercises are designed to release tightness and provide fast relief, even in as little as 30 seconds.

Each exercise works a little differently, targeting these muscles from various positions. For the best results, try them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and start relieving upper back pain in seconds!

Link to foam roller: https://amzn.to/44xowPQ
